threads.title: Israel's deadlocked election and coalition talks
threads.summary: Israel voted on 27 October 2026 in its first election since the Gaza war. Neither Netanyahu's right-wing bloc (about 53-56 seats) nor Gadi Eisenkot's bloc reached the 61 needed. Likud alleged fraud by Arab parties without evidence. President Herzog began consulting party leaders. On 2 November officials said the results stand, while Netanyahu claimed the election was 'stolen'. Watch whom Herzog asks to form a government.

last_state.fact: No bloc has 61 seats; both Netanyahu and Eisenkot claim they can form a government
Likud accused Arab parties of fraud, with no evidence; fact-checkers and election officials disputed it
Herzog consulting party leaders; Netanyahu reportedly wants unity government with Eisenkot
Up to 480,000 soldier, police and diplomat ballots were still being counted

A Harvard tool gives Democrats 96% (House) and 76% (Senate) chances. An NBC poll has it 52–45 for a Democratic Congress. A judge dismissed the Alaska certification suit. Michigan Democrat Haley Stevens endorsed Republican Mike Rogers. Results from about 4:30 a.m. IST on 4 November.

threads.title: Iran Hormuz tanker attacks and oil prices
threads.summary: The Iran war began in late February 2026. On 31 October Trump said one or two Iranian sites remained to be hit, and Mojtaba Khamenei ordered an unrestricted response to any threat. Iran says talks in Qatar could reopen Hormuz in two days if the US lifts its port blockade and eases oil and gas sanctions. The US has not publicly replied. Iran's Revolutionary Guards claimed two tankers hit mines on 1 November (unverified). Brent fell about 3% on 2 November.

threads.title: France cost-of-living protests against Macron

On 17 October hundreds of thousands marched; over 2,400 arrests were reported in one account and about 1,000 officers were injured. Another rally drew over 400,000. On 31 October more than 300,000 marched, some in Halloween costumes, ending in clashes with masked rioters. A general strike is set for 5 November.

threads.title: RBI rate hike and rising Indian inflation
threads.summary: The RBI raised the repo rate 0.25 points to 5.5% in October 2026, its first hike since February 2023. Retail inflation rose to 5.54% in September from 4.83%, led by food (onions up 108%). Banks are resetting floating-rate home loans, about ₹770 more a month on a ₹50 lakh loan. October GST rose 22.9% to ₹2.31 lakh crore, but Mint reports demand stress in pockets from West Asia war inflation.

threads.title: SEBI wants foreign investors freed from long-term capital gains tax
threads.summary: On 2 November 2026 Reuters reported that SEBI recommended scrapping long-term capital gains tax (now 12.5%) for foreign investors. SEBI also proposed exempting mutual fund investors who switch funds. The proposals are advisory; the government decides, possibly in the February 2027 Budget. Foreign investors sold a record $31 billion of Indian stocks in 2026. Jefferies and Raamdeo Agrawal are positive. Bernstein's Garre is sceptical. JM Financial flags lost revenue.
